name: Mikoshiba Kyousuke
source:
Year: 2nd Year
Favorite Subject: History
Favorite Thing: General Exercise
Family: Four siblings that include three older sisters
Things that he isn’t good with: Things like skinship
Foods that he isn’t good with: Something Sweet
Favorite Words: Half of life is in trouble, while the other half is to overcome it.

The heroine’s classmate. The type has an violent mouth but is the first to take action, the roots of his grades and performance in class are serious also in the top-class. Often acts together with the student council president [url=/c6090]Yuuto[/url], the two together are labelled [KY combi]. When something annoying rises, he listens to music pretending not to listen, is also the troubleshooter (solution shop) that cannot leave people who are in trouble.
